Before you ask.

How much does an office or retail fitout cost in Dubai?

Office fitouts typically start from AED 1,500 per square metre depending on specification, with retail and F&B quoted per scope. After a site visit you receive a detailed, fixed-scope quotation, never vague per-day pricing.

How long does a fitout take?

A typical office fitout runs 4 to 8 weeks and retail units 3 to 6 weeks, depending on size and approvals. We plan backwards from your required opening date.

Do you handle authority approvals?

Yes. Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence, DEWA and building management approvals are part of our scope, with drawings, NOCs and permits included.

Can you work around mall or building hours?

Yes. Night shifts and after-hours work are planned in from day one where the mall or building requires it, so your schedule doesn't slip.

Do you fit out clinics and medical spaces?

Yes. Clinic and medical fitouts including branded reception, consultation rooms and patient areas, coordinated with the relevant health authority requirements alongside DM, Civil Defence and DEWA approvals.

Do you also do office renovations, not just new fitouts?

Yes. We renovate and upgrade existing offices and stores as well as fitting out shell-and-core units.

Is there a warranty?

Yes. Our workmanship is covered by warranty, and we return to resolve any snags after handover.
